title: CoAdapt-GUI: Joint Workflow Context and Policy Adaptation for Unseen GUI Applications
abstract: arXiv:2608.11588v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Mobile GUI agents remain brittle when deployed to applications absent from source training. We study novel-app generalization under a limited target interaction budget and without target demonstrations. We introduce CoAdapt-GUI, a test-time adaptation (TTA) framework that jointly adapts structured workflow context and policy from the agent's own target-app rollouts and rewards. The workflow context retains transferable procedures, failure modes, and verification rules while excluding app-bound source details. This separation allows reusable workflow knowledge to guide adaptation without transferring source-interface state. For policy adaptation, task-context-matched group-relative optimization updates a LoRA adapter on a frozen vision-language model. translated_title: CoAdapt-GUI：面向未见GUI应用的联合工作流上下文与策略自适应
translated_abstract: 移动GUI代理在部署到源训练中未出现的应用程序时仍显得脆弱。我们研究了在有限目标交互预算且无目标演示的情况下，针对新应用泛化的问题。我们引入了CoAdapt-GUI，一种测试时自适应（TTA）框架，它从代理自身的目标应用回放和奖励中，联合调整结构化工作流上下文和策略。工作流上下文保留可迁移的过程、失败模式和验证规则，同时排除与应用绑定的源细节。这种分离使得可重用的工作流知识能够指导自适应，而无需转移源接口状态。对于策略自适应，任务上下文匹配的组相对优化更新冻结的视觉语言模型上的LoRA适配器。在两个未见应用的评估中，CoAdapt-GUI在AndroidWorld-Generalization上达到45.0%，而报告的策略仅TTA基线为37.5%，并提升了AndroidWorld Plus的性能。
tldr: CoAdapt-GUI通过联合调整工作流上下文和策略，实现了对未见GUI应用的高效测试时自适应，显著提升了泛化性能。
en_tdlr: CoAdapt-GUI jointly adapts workflow context and policy for test-time generalization to unseen GUI applications, significantly improving performance over policy-only baselines.
